R02.title: Contact Models in Robotics: a Comparative Analysis

R03.title: Validating Robotics Simulators on Real-World Impacts

findings.title: Task-bounded physical fidelity
findings.source_finding: Contact models make different physical and numerical approximations.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Qualify accuracy by interaction, material, load and speed, not by engine name.
findings.verification_gate: Publish an applicability envelope and held-out physical errors.

findings.title: Fit parameters against measured trajectories
findings.source_finding: MuJoCo sysid fits model parameters using recorded sensor data and bounded optimization.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Add a calibration module with separate fitting and held-out evaluation sequences.
findings.verification_gate: Report baseline versus fitted prediction errors on unseen measurements.

findings.title: Physically realizable inertial estimates
findings.source_finding: MuJoCo sysid supports physically consistent inertia parameterization.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Fit mass/COM/inertia jointly when observable; retain parameter uncertainty.
findings.verification_gate: Reject nonphysical inertia; examine sensitivity and identification ambiguity.

findings.title: Sensor delay is not joint friction
findings.source_finding: Sysid distinguishes measurement corrections from physical model parameters.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Model sensor bias/delay independently to avoid fitting timing errors as dynamics.
findings.verification_gate: Validate synchronized timestamps and delay estimates.

findings.title: Asset provenance before reconstruction
findings.source_finding: Menagerie proposes parameter-provenance grades; its README does not guarantee every model has an assigned grade.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Use native models as comparison baselines; record a published grade only where available.
findings.verification_gate: Record asset revision, parameter origins, unknown grade and unresolved properties.

findings.title: Actuator models need more than joint limits
findings.source_finding: Isaac Lab exposes several actuator models and separates model limits from solver limits.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Store controller, saturation, delay, motor inertia and speed-dependent behavior.
findings.verification_gate: Step/load sweeps must respect actual driver and continuous limits.

findings.title: Action semantics are part of the environment
findings.source_finding: robosuite distinguishes action/controller modes and simulation versus policy rates.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Version units, frames, absolute/delta commands, gains, hold rules and action scaling.
findings.verification_gate: Replay the same action under the same controller contract.

findings.title: Action replay and state replay differ
findings.source_finding: ManiSkill can replay recorded states to recover observations, or replay controls.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Label render-only state playback separately from forward-dynamics rollouts.
findings.verification_gate: Reject state-forced videos as evidence of forward-dynamics accuracy.

findings.title: Synchronization survives dataset export
findings.source_finding: LeRobot organizes multimodal signals, video and episode metadata.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Use a canonical timed transition record; keep capture/release times and export mappings.
findings.verification_gate: Round-trip timestamps, shapes, units and episode boundaries.

findings.title: Preserve state for debugging
findings.source_finding: robomimic datasets can store simulator states and environment metadata.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Save state checkpoints and metadata beside policy-visible observations.
findings.verification_gate: Restore a checkpoint under a pinned runtime and compare within tolerance.

findings.title: Demonstration generation needs task structure
findings.source_finding: MimicGen generates demonstrations by adapting source demonstrations to new scenes.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Track source demo, task phases, object frames, attempts and generator configuration.
findings.verification_gate: Hold out source demonstrations and object families; report generation failures.

findings.title: Scene diversity must be designed
findings.source_finding: DROID was collected across many real-world scenes and tasks.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Specify object, layout, camera and interaction coverage; do not equate frame count with diversity.
findings.verification_gate: Evaluate on held-out scene/object families rather than adjacent frames.

findings.title: Randomized mass and inertia must agree
findings.source_finding: Isaac Lab includes mass randomization with inertia recomputation/scaling options.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Sample physically coupled parameters; fixed-geometry mass scaling scales inertia too.
findings.verification_gate: Verify positive inertia and correct COM reference after every sampled reset.

findings.title: Cross-engine comparison is diagnostic
findings.source_finding: Isaac Lab documents policy transfer between engines and targeted randomization.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Use a second engine only after a pinned nominal baseline; investigate disagreement.
findings.verification_gate: Compare trajectories/events; agreement alone is not physical validation.

findings.title: Sensors have independent clocks
findings.source_finding: Isaac Lab sensors use their own update periods in simulated time.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Separate physics, controller, camera and sensor rates; record latency and exposure.
findings.verification_gate: Policy observations cannot include measurements released after decision time.

findings.title: Seeds are insufficient for exact replay
findings.source_finding: MuJoCo documents state, solver warmstart and numerical reproducibility considerations.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Store engine/build/hardware details, full supported state, RNG/controller state and tolerances.
findings.verification_gate: Test continuation; avoid claiming cross-platform bitwise identity.

findings.title: Dataset formats do not fix action mismatch
findings.source_finding: robomimic multi-dataset training requires compatible observation/action spaces.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Add explicit adapters and loss/units documentation rather than merely convert containers.
findings.verification_gate: Reject incompatible control spaces without a declared tested transform.

findings.title: Visual realism is a separate acceptance track
findings.source_finding: Dynamics replay and observation extraction can be separate stages in ManiSkill.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Drive rendering from authoritative simulated states; test visual labels/calibration separately.
findings.verification_gate: Check image-depth-pose alignment and distinguish depiction from sensor simulation.

findings.title: Peak and sustained capability need distinct metadata
findings.source_finding: Actuator implementations include torque/velocity limits and delay models.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Retain peak duration and thermal assumptions; unknown continuous capability blocks that claim.
findings.verification_gate: Bounded-duration load tests and declared actuator envelope.

findings.title: Publication must attach validation evidence
findings.source_finding: Impact studies compare simulations against measured real-world trajectories.
findings.proposed_solution_change: Create publication levels: synthetic-only, engine-checked, calibrated-envelope, transfer-tested.
findings.verification_gate: No physics-accuracy label without a scoped report and measured evidence.
